audit.scope: Source reconciliation plus integrated host stereo API; no runtime campaign executed.
audit.native_stereo: Host/API slice inspected; native build and hot/cold/paired acceptance are separate integration gates.
audit.macro: Pending until its separate code patch is integrated and independently reviewed.

coverage.partition: Every inventory identifier appears in exactly one work_group; dependencies and campaigns may reuse groups.

order: Run inventory-and-public-host to establish route/schema coverage.
Run only affected existing host/native/paired test_sets on hash-pinned runtimes, with require flags and no unaccounted native skips.
Implement and independently test each remaining primitive/adapter before trying to qualify its blocked consumers.
Run the seven actual compatibility campaigns; reuse a fresh receipt across rows only when its assertions cover each row.
Review row-level evidence and declared semantic differences before any qualification field is changed; default/removal policy remains separate.
stop_conditions: A missing input/extension, native skip, unsupported primitive or incomplete observation is an open gate, not a pass.
No sum of host/authored-test counts qualifies vendor or whole-game behavior.
Record runtime/test/source/input hashes and exact test nodes; use private paths for licensed payloads and bulky runtime evidence.
execution.test_selection: The 40 test sets are reusable affected-contract selections, not a mandatory rerun of every file after each edit. To close all 141 rows, each minimum_acceptance obligation needs fresh direct evidence; unsupported primitives require new checks before their consumers can qualify.

dosbox.note: tests/conftest.py requires a real FDISBULL_DOSBOX executable for this flag; all required native cases must execute without unaccounted skips.

work_groups.title: Whole stopped-control, routing and failure contract
remaining_work: Compare remaining legacy continue/pause/wait, breakpoint-list and reply-schema obligations; the existing paired COM covers registers, memory, one breakpoint/step and exit only.
Keep legacy direct-write refusals distinct from explicitly guarded machine-context writes; complete saved-script vocabulary admission per operation.
minimum_acceptance: Same original COM/MZ bytes and immutable source/disk inputs; correct context, widths, stop cause and selected-process lifecycle.
Python, JSON and saved scripts agree on admitted operation and single execution; invalid input and unsupported operations refuse before effects.
Dispatch uncertainty/deadline/persistence failures close and reap the owner, preserve evidence, and never retry on another backend.

work_groups.title: Source binding, ownership, protected DOS and lifecycle
remaining_work: Complete paired MZ relocation/PSP/MCB, nested EXEC, TSR, authored SYS and protected-source observations; distinguish admitted source bytes from process/allocation/task lifetime.
Run actual vendor QEMM/DESQview campaigns separately; FDBTASK1 and authored protected-mode witnesses cannot replace them.
minimum_acceptance: Original entry/relocation/loader writes match independent source, CPU and DOS allocation evidence.
LE code relation is revalidated at stopped boundaries; owner, page, source, mode or generation change retires stale authority.
Child return, selected-process exit, TSR residency, debugger close and emulator death remain distinct; cold restore grants fresh authority only.

work_groups.title: Legacy runtime-memory binding/read/write adapter
remaining_work: Implement the three legacy routes over explicit QEMU source/task/page lifetimes, or produce an explicitly reviewed equivalent contract; do not alias physical RAM or LE code relation to allocation ownership.
Add native/public/script tests for bind/read/guarded-write, stale source/page/task/epoch refusal, self-modification and restore.
minimum_acceptance: A binding names exact source or runtime range, mapping and lifetime; mutation validates the preimage and refuses foreign/retired authority before writes.
Same authorized inputs have paired observable outcomes; historical bindings remain readable but cannot regain live mutation authority.

work_groups.title: Source and machine traces, events and clock joins
remaining_work: Qualify paired event predicates and semantic differences for faults, partial REP, IRQ/timer policy, overlays and departure from admitted COM/MZ or explicit embedded-LE source.
Supply the persistent before-fetch trace/cursor contract required by trace.start/read/stop; a bounded stopped trace is not that streaming primitive.
minimum_acceptance: Observed instruction bytes, canonical source identity, mode and epochs survive artifact reopening without manufacturing retirement or absence.
Unknown completion and unbound endpoints remain unknown; exact event/action and clock identities are validated before execution.

work_groups.title: Clock, waits, physical input and stop precedence
remaining_work: Compare the full legacy guest_ms/fast_forward, input-state and consumption contracts; callback acceptance and owned leases alone do not establish guest state.
Add paired same-input timing/consumption cases for layout, repeats, cancellation, nested hooks and stop precedence where existing authored cases are narrower.
minimum_acceptance: One shrinking host deadline and one declared guest clock; original earlier/coincident stop wins without replay.
Guest BIOS/IRQ or application state independently observes every required press/type/release; retained-prefix and held-lease recovery is correct.
Queue, arm, run, cancellation and persistence failure semantics agree through Python, JSON and saved scripts.

work_groups.title: Whole frame/coherence, raw pixels and frame-input contract
remaining_work: Implement legacy frame_probe and frame_rgba consumers, including codec/stride/pixel hash and exact guarded identity.
Establish a real completed-guest-frame/mode/revision boundary or a reviewed paired semantic disposition. A renderer publication/retrace edge is not a completed guest frame.
Qualify frame step and key scheduling at that boundary, including partial drawing, palette/mode/origin changes, typematic behavior and restore without reinjection.
minimum_acceptance: Observation bundle joins pixels, frame/mode/revision identity, clock and input ownership atomically; stale/mixed bundles refuse.
Delayed drawing distinguishes controller delivery, guest consumption and completed presentation using an independent guest oracle.
Python/JSON/scripts and cold histories preserve exact pixel/key identity and reject foreign epochs.

work_groups.title: Absolute/frame-relative click and guest mouse consumption
remaining_work: Implement debug-click/debug-click-frame and equivalent input.mouse.click using observed guest cursor/range and exact frame/mode guards.
Add an actual DOS mouse driver INT33 oracle for range, clipping, acceleration/scale, consumed motion/button edges and release; caller-declared relative scale is not absolute cursor state.
minimum_acceptance: The same requested coordinate lands on the same qualified target on both backends; stale frame/mode and unsupported driver state fail before input.
Timed click failure preserves delivered prefix and reconciles held buttons without hidden replay.

work_groups.title: Native state, Anchor Stones, control and source recovery
remaining_work: Complete paired acceptance/disposition for raw, source-bound COM/MZ, owned-machine and LE checkpoints; do not exchange their authority or backend state files.
Reconcile selected CPU/RAM/device/IRQ/timer/input/file/control continuation after hot and separate-Python cold restore, including actual game/device workloads.
minimum_acceptance: CPU/RAM/disk plus admitted pending device state and future behavior agree after restore; handles/tokens/epochs are new.
Malformed archive/core/preimage/source/control identity rejects before authority publication; uncertain fresh destinations are closed.
Host files are restored only under explicit workspace policy, never inferred from a VM checkpoint.

work_groups.title: RAM/fetch layers, hooks, code and selected controls
remaining_work: Provide and qualify source-addressed LE layer/hook/trial authority where absent. Existing LE binding proves a stopped code relation and does not revive the old MZ source/allocation authority; explicit machine addresses remain a separate control contract.
Complete paired hook/layer ordering, guards, repeat/once, self-modification, active precedence and cold control rebinding.
minimum_acceptance: Guest data, instruction fetch, debugger RAM and device views obey declared separate visibility; warmed translations and aliases cannot bypass guards.
Callbacks act only at an owned stopped boundary; partial actions and stale mappings never masquerade as full completion.

work_groups.title: Screenshot preparation hooks and coherent capture
remaining_work: Implement the screenshot-hooks adapter with explicit source, control and capture identity, bounded execution and cleanup.
Add native and paired tests for preparation effects, failure rollback/recovery, incomplete renderer output and hook teardown.
minimum_acceptance: Only a completed admitted preparation action can qualify the resulting coherent image; errors retain the original stop/evidence and restore or invalidate controls.

work_groups.title: Rewind, selected undo, timelines and comparative trials
remaining_work: Run complete branches, rewind, selected undo/freeze/recovery, full/delta retention and baseline/candidate trials on matched source/control/input cases.
Complete directory/file-aware history composition and full frame equivalence; renderer DAGs and bounded stopped LE capture histories retain their narrower contracts.
minimum_acceptance: Unrecorded mutations invalidate live cursors; selected inverse cannot execute until a full checkpoint recovers unselected state.
Cold restart reconstructs exact retained bytes and fresh identities; key ownership returns without reinjection; storage caps include retained/reconstructed payloads.
Each trial starts from the same full baseline and recovers it at the end; missing or misaligned observations cannot prove equality.

work_groups.title: Checkpointed file services, proven saves and explicit export
remaining_work: Qualify the declared runtime/filesystem/version matrix beyond the bounded FreeDOS workspace fixtures and real game save/load paths.
Compose file state with histories/trials; keep caller-attested closed/flushed output distinct from proven guest-create/overwrite/rename operations.
minimum_acceptance: Open handle offsets, dirty buffers, findnext cursor, subdirectories and staged generations survive cold restore without the original host tree.
Original host files remain unchanged until explicit exclusive export; partial export, disk-full, stale preimage and unsupported handle state are observable.
Proven create/overwrite/seek/truncate/rename and safe-stop keep policy retain exact operation authority and do not run inside suppressed script/trial/history contexts.

work_groups.title: Macros, movement and proof consumer adapters
remaining_work: Integrate and independently review the bounded native macro adapter before changing its availability; it was absent during this audit.
Implement movement/proof adapters with explicit physical versus assisted action policy, source/control and total budget bounds.
Add public/script/native and paired scenarios for partial input, early stop, lost ownership and actual observed effects.
minimum_acceptance: Actions use admitted native primitives once, reconcile holds, preserve original stop and evidence, and never claim an unmet postcondition.
Successful macro composition does not by itself qualify movement, proof, scenes or completed-frame semantics.

work_groups.title: Scene, spatial, text and higher workflow contracts
remaining_work: Add explicit native adapters after frame/input/source/control dependencies are qualified; importing the DOSBox mixins is insufficient.
Create native source-bound scene scenarios with actual readiness, named input, text/spatial observation, progression and failure recovery; compare the same goals/observables under DOSBox.
minimum_acceptance: Exact domain/frame/state identity guards every observation and action; stale readiness and unsupported policies fail before effects.
Physical, assisted, story and fair-play claims remain explicit, with actual guest progression and release/recovery evidence.

work_groups.title: CLI/JSON, IDA, packaging and offline consumer path
remaining_work: Add the native DOS backend to the IDA endpoint: current constructor/parser accept only dosbox and dosbox-qemu.
Exercise the packaged wheel/offline runtime in a clean process through serve/debug, IDA and capability/doctor discovery; retain explicit refusals and backend selection.
minimum_acceptance: The installed artifact exposes the same admitted contracts as source; missing native extensions never launch another backend silently.
A real remote consumer completes a bounded inspect/action/reopen workflow with the intended native context and immutable source.

work_groups.title: Explicit spectator window and host-input filtering
remaining_work: Implement explicit native spectator/dot-mode selection and host-input filtering; do not substitute headless capture for a requested visible window.
Add native window/lifecycle/input-isolation acceptance at the real UI boundary.
minimum_acceptance: The requested window is observable, controls/cleanup remain owned, and ordinary host input cannot bypass the declared agent-input policy.

work_groups.title: Planned UDL/UIL block services disposition
remaining_work: This existing required inventory row remains open. Either implement its declared production contract or obtain a separate explicit inventory disposition; lab tests cannot qualify it or remove it from the gate.
minimum_acceptance: Region priority/mask/epoch, original/replacement effect authority, pending services, joins, cancellation, duplicate notification and restore identity are independently exercised.

work_groups.title: Actual DOS hardware, vendor drivers and games
remaining_work: Complete the seven explicit campaigns below on declared, hash-pinned real workloads and runtime/driver configurations.
Parser tests, DOSBox absence probes, FDBTASK1 scheduling, one game and historical private receipts do not establish arbitrary QEMM/DESQview/device compatibility.
minimum_acceptance: Each declared BIOS/disk/graphics/sound/IRQ/EMS/XMS/A20/paging/driver case has independently observed guest outcomes and reproducible runtime provenance.

supporting_work.implemented: Optional s16-stereo capture is scoped to virtual sb16-opl; u8-mono remains default and old-command compatible.
remaining: Finish native build and asymmetric stereo/whole-frame/overflow/core4 corruption/hot+cold future checks; keep old mono checkpoint acceptance.
Resolve or explicitly qualify the documented SB16 single-cycle stereo length mismatch, DC/rail behavior, guest mixer gain application, bounded/long/rolling capture and actual game audio expectations.

missing_checks: Paired MZ/PSP/MCB/relocation, nested EXEC, TSR and authored SYS driver semantics beyond the existing paired COM controls/exit.
accept: Original COM and MZ enter with independently verified bytes/registers, complete child/parent/TSR outcomes, source isolation and cleanup.
Same workload through Python, JSON and script routes observes equivalent admitted outcomes; unsupported context/address differences are declared.

missing_checks: A repository-reproducible native QEMM/EMM386 campaign with an authorized private image and selected driver configuration; current parser and authored protected/V86 tests do not load the vendor driver.
accept: Observe actual EMS/XMS/A20 and protected/V86 page/segment behavior, guarded source/runtime memory and device I/O under each declared manager.
Cold recovery rejects stale allocation/task/page authority and preserves demonstrated future execution.

missing_checks: Turn the bounded private DESQview witness into a reproducible declared campaign: actual vendor tasks, switch/exit/reuse, observed memory ownership and I/O, cold recovery with fresh authority.
accept: Real DESQview task transitions agree with guest-observed identity/lifetime; address/CR3 coincidence never transfers authority.
FDBTASK1 cooperation and native authored PIC scheduling remain separate supporting tests, not vendor equivalence.

missing_checks: Reproduce a declared protected real-game route with ordinary startup, consumed keyboard/mouse, graphics/audio, gameplay, save/load, cold replay and guest exit.

Tic-Tac-Toe has paired full-round/replay/reset/exit tests; Five Dice and Snake add source-assisted complete-game/RNG and keyboard/growth/clock/exit. These assetless fixtures do not cover protected games, file assets, INT33 mouse coordinates or broad audio fidelity.
accept: Use the same hash-pinned original program/assets and declared input route on both backends; compare application/state outcomes and independently justified media metrics.
No private RAM/register edits, muted devices, paused-only inspection or missing media may silently stand in for the requested ordinary workload.

missing_checks: Run the existing PE32 and Win16 actual GUI/input/scene/spectator witnesses on their separately pinned runtimes after shared host changes.
accept: Existing Windows original-process, keyboard/mouse, named scenes, dot mode, cleanup and exception contracts remain intact.
Missing private runtime/fixture inputs or skipped native cases remain missing evidence.

missing_checks: Compose real workload CPU/RAM/device/media/input/file/control state with separate-Python restore and compare future continuation, not only restored metadata.
accept: Fresh owner/token/capture epoch; stale bindings and keys refuse; no reinjected consumed input or changed source originals.
Full device state, timer/IRQ phase, PCM prefix/future, frame publication, open-file cursor and selected control state satisfy their declared contracts.

missing_checks: Run explicit backend selection in a clean installed kit for dosbox, dosbox-qemu and qemu-dos using the same authorized target; include doctor/setup failure and normal cleanup.

Existing paired tests plus the required tests/test_dos_qemu.py lane exercise all three backend families, but a clean installed/offline package and explicit failure/fallback-selection rehearsal remain required.
accept: Both retained selectors remain usable; no automatic retry/fallback after an uncertain action.
Each backend launches its own compatible state/runtime; DOSBox save files are never loaded as QEMU checkpoints.
Default stays dosbox until all 141 surfaces and seven campaigns have reviewed evidence; removal remains a separate review.

evidence_required_per_qualified_surface: surface identifier and exact required contract/disposition
implementation/source commit and runtime binary/firmware/driver hashes
same-input identity and independent observable oracle; declared semantic differences
exact native test/campaign nodes, result, no missing required skips, retained evidence identities
affected DOSBox regression and public/consumer routes
recovery/epoch/failure evidence where the surface owns state or effects
